episodes.name: Patience
episodes.overview: While Sam and the ghosts race to find him, Isaac comes face to face with Puritan ghost Patience for the first time since she was lost in the dirt.

episodes.name: Sam's Dad
episodes.overview: When Sam's dad comes to Woodstone for a visit, Patience puts their father-daughter relationship to the test. Also, Isaac must deal with the fallout from his breakup with Nigel, and Thor and Flower handle an awkward situation with Nancy.

episodes.name: Halloween 4: The Witch
episodes.overview: The Ghosts seeking some excitement during a low key Halloween join Patience in putting Sam on a witch trial.

episodes.name: The Work Retreat
episodes.overview: Trevor, who has catfished his way into a remote financial analyst job, is in hot water when he's summoned to a mandatory in-person work retreat. Also, Hetty and Sass start a rumor about Pete.

episodes.name: A Star Is Dead
episodes.overview: Alberta offers to help Sam prepare for an audition for a community theater production. Also, Sass finds a new reason to interfere in Jay's dreams.

episodes.name: The Primary Source
episodes.overview: When Sam's book publisher requires source material for her biography on Isaac, she and Jay take a field trip to find a diary he claims he hid when he was alive.

episodes.name: Sad Farnsby
episodes.overview: When Sam accidentally creates a rift between Sam and Jay's neighbors, the Farnsbys, Henry Farnsby moves into Woodstone B&B. Also, Isaac and Nigel battle over a belated wedding present.

episodes.name: A Very Arondekar Christmas (1)
episodes.overview: A leaky water heater mishap threatens to ruin holiday plans as Sam and Jay prepare to host Jay's hard-to-please dad, difficult-to-impress mom and sister Bela.

episodes.name: A Very Arondekar Christmas (2)
episodes.overview: A leaky water heater mishap threatens to ruin holiday plans as Sam and Jay prepare to host Jay's hard-to-please dad, difficult-to-impress mom and sister Bela.

episodes.name: The Not-So-Silent Partner
episodes.overview: Sam and Jay are forced to cover when Mark demands to meet the silent investor in Jay's restaurant who has been holding up construction.

episodes.name: Thorapy 2: Abandonment Issues
episodes.overview: Thor returns to therapy to work through his angst over being abandoned by his Viking shipmates. Also, Jay's sister, Bela, attempts to help him with the restaurant.

episodes.name: It's the End of the World as We Know It and What Were We Talking About?
episodes.overview: Flower interferes with the opening of Jay's restaurant based on a prophecy from her old cult leader.

episodes.name: Ghostfellas
episodes.overview: Jay angers a local restaurateur when he uses a recipe at his restaurant that was given to him by Pete.

episodes.name: Alexander Hamilton and the Ruffle Kerfuffle
episodes.overview: When Jay becomes obsessed with the success of a fellow chef, Isaac serves up a cautionary tale about his own rivalry with Alexander Hamilton; Elias Woodstone returns from hell with a limited-time offer for the ghosts.

episodes.name: The Bachelorette Party
episodes.overview: When Alberta's descendant hosts a bachelorette party at Woodstone Mansion, Alberta becomes suspicious of her fiancé; Jay is excited about a positive review on his restaurant.

episodes.name: St. Hetty's Day
episodes.overview: Hetty's ghost power is revealed when Jay's cousin Sunil visits Woodstone Mansion on St. Patrick's Day.

episodes.name: His Girl Shiki
episodes.overview: Pete makes good on his promise to find someone for Sasappis by bringing in a wisecracking 1940s screenwriter who also has the ability to roam.

episodes.name: Smooching and Smushing
episodes.overview: Jay, Sam and the ghosts attempt to fix the ghost trap in hopes of getting Sasappis across the ghost boundary to visit his longtime crush, Shiki.

episodes.name: Pinkus Returns
episodes.overview: When Trevor's former co-worker Pinkus and his daughter Abby show up at Woodstone Mansion, Trevor gets the surprise of his afterlife.

episodes.name: I Know What You Did Thirty-Seven Summers Ago
episodes.overview: When Sam and Jay host a fundraiser for the mayor to earn a favor for Jay's restaurant, they learn of his bizarre connection to one of Woodstone's ghosts.

episodes.name: Kyle
episodes.overview: Sam and Jay's relationship is tested when Kyle, a handsome living who shares Sam's ability to see ghosts, arrives at Woodstone B&B.

episodes.name: The Devil Went Down to Woodstone
episodes.overview: Sam and Jay host a big party for the launch of Sam and Isaac's vampire book.
